description: California Transit Stops is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. Use GTFS schedule trips, stoptimes, shapes, and stops to estimate whether corridor segments have scheduled headways of 20 minutes or less. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, High Quality Transit. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
